items.name: 20-round magazine
items.description: Steel box, twenty rounds, one bad day.

items.name: 30-round magazine
items.description: Longer and heavier. Fewer reloads, more swearing when it snags on a vine.

items.name: Field dressing
items.description: Press firmly. Think of something nice. Heals 35 over a few seconds (H).

items.name: Sticky rice parcel
items.description: Wrapped in a banana leaf by somebody's grandmother. Heals 15, and morale.

items.name: 6x field scope
items.description: The rifle's own scope. Long, heavy, honest. Six times closer.

items.name: 4x combat scope
items.description: Shorter and wider than the factory glass: easier to find a target, a bit less zoom.

items.name: Red dot sight
items.description: No zoom. Fast. Put the dot on it.

items.name: Holographic sight
items.description: A ring and a dot floating in a window. A little zoom, a lot of style.

items.name: Flash hider
items.description: Factory fit. Hides a bit of the flash from you, none of the noise from them.

items.name: Suppressor
items.description: Not silent, whatever the films say. Guards hear it about a third as far, and see no flash.

items.name: Compensator
items.description: Throws the blast sideways and keeps the muzzle down. Less kick, more noise.

items.name: Weapon light
items.description: Turns night into day, a cone at a time (L). Guards can see it too, from far away.

items.name: Laser pointer
items.description: A red line from you to them (L). Steadier shots from the hip.

items.name: Vertical foregrip
items.description: Something to hold on to. Less recoil, steadier aim.

items.name: Sack of rice
items.description: Twenty kilos of somebody's harvest, for somebody else's dinner. Heavy, lumpy, important.

items.name: Field radio
items.description: Heavy, olive, crackly. Set it up somewhere quiet and that's home: operations, news and gossip come through it. (Right-click: set up camp here.)

items.name: Building supplies
items.description: Planks, sandbags, tin sheet, rope, nails. Whatever wasn't nailed down at their camp. Build with it at the radio.

items.name: Intel
items.description: What you came for. Don't lose it, don't read it, don't spill rice on it.
